en: A monochrome postcard showing a brick façade with two large arched windows and, above them, two Gothic pointed arches filled with sculpted high‑relief scenes. A circular window with stone surround sits above the reliefs. The architecture appears medieval. Printed caption text runs along the bottom margin, with small vertical printing along the right edge and a star‑like printer's mark at the lower left.
